item_name: WB Mesh V8 source alignment audit

verified_findings.origin: Pre-existing global lookup assumption remains in V8 receipt and reservation APIs
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 5.4 and 7.3 require stock to be scoped to SKU and node and reservations to affect the selected source only.
verified_findings.evidence: InventoryManager.receive checks existing batchId only within one node; getItem(batchId) searches every node and returns the first match. Runtime reproduction accepted batch duplicate-batch at both pvz-perm-plus and pvz-perm-krasnov, and reserve(duplicate-batch,1,test) selected pvz-perm-plus.
verified_findings.impact: A repeated human batch code at two nodes can reserve or issue stock at the wrong physical node. Imported duplicate batch IDs are also unchecked.

verified_findings.origin: Existing aging mutation becomes inconsistent with the new V8 journal reconciliation
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 5.4 and 7.3 require all physical stock bucket changes to be reconstructible from events.
verified_findings.evidence: Runtime reproduction: new StateManager().stepTime(61*24) quarantines expired lots, but reconcile().success becomes false because ageInventory changes status without auditEvent.
verified_findings.impact: Virtual-clock testing alone produces unexplained stock differences.

verified_findings.origin: Required failure behavior is not implemented in current route pipeline
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 1.1, 5.3 and 7.8 require new orders to use C1/C2 when MCS is unavailable.
verified_findings.evidence: Runtime reproduction: setting state.mcsStatus to error before creating a local order still selects M1. RouteOptimizer.findCandidates/build do not read MCS availability.
verified_findings.impact: The displayed MCS failure state does not change routing policy.

verified_findings.requirement: TZ section 5.5 and presentation slide 5 require mandatory withdrawal of expired stock after 60 days.
verified_findings.evidence: At 61 virtual days transfers.length remains zero. InventoryManager.ageBatches sets withdrawalRequired; StateManager.ageInventory quarantines. Neither creates or executes withdrawal to the city hub.
verified_findings.impact: The source presentation claim is not backed by a working withdrawal process.

verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 4.3, 5.6 and 6.3 require measured packing bonuses, courier-delay penalties, hourly operation limits and queue impact.
verified_findings.evidence: The reviewed order-operations.js transitions do not calculate packing minutes, actual operational bonuses or penalties. CostEngine.calculatePvzPayout adds a fixed bonus pool. Hourly operationalSlots is checked as a static positive number, not consumed per virtual hour.
verified_findings.impact: Slow packing and repeated operations within one hour do not affect the partner result or effective throughput as specified.

verified_findings.origin: Required multi-lot FIFO support is absent
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 6.2 and 7.3 require FIFO stock-lot handling for SKU/node balances.
verified_findings.evidence: RouteOptimizer.findCandidates filters individual lots with available(i)>=order.quantity. Multiple lots whose aggregate availability satisfies an order cannot be reserved together.
verified_findings.impact: Two available lots of 30 units cannot fulfill an order of 40 despite 60 physically available units.

verified_findings.origin: Required consolidation pipeline remains separate from ordinary order routing
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 3.3 and 5.2 and presentation slide 2 require dynamic consolidation, future dispatch windows and existing transport use.
verified_findings.evidence: RouteOptimizer.build uses batchSize:order.quantity. It does not obtain the ordinary order batch size from a shared trip or candidate arrival forecast. The new planning-engine schedules forecast-driven stock movements, but this does not consolidate ordinary buyer orders.
verified_findings.impact: A one-unit buyer order is evaluated as a one-parcel dedicated trip even when compatible orders could share one departure.

verified_findings.requirement: TZ section 5.5 requires inspected returns to be restocked only with sufficient forecast demand, otherwise transferred or returned to hub; actual disposition cost must be charged once.
verified_findings.evidence: InventoryManager.resolveQuarantine permits resell with inspection.fit===true only; there is no demand check. processReturn records a profit reversal and an inspection payout but does not charge a seller return-disposition cost. The workspace inspection button only confirms fitness.
verified_findings.impact: An unneeded inspected item can return to available stock and seller economics omit the actual return route cost.

verified_findings.origin: Forecast target-stock formula differs from the supplied TZ
verified_findings.requirement: TZ section 5.8 specifies sigma=MAD*1.4826 and sparse-demand shrinkage.
verified_findings.evidence: forecast-engine.js recommend sets sigma=f.mae*1.4826. MAE is a forecast error average; it is not median absolute deviation. No sparse-local-history shrinkage is present in the reviewed implementation.
verified_findings.impact: Target stocks and transfer quantities are generated from a different dispersion model than the claimed source.

verified_findings.origin: Source dataset scope differs from implemented demo scope
verified_findings.requirement: TZ sections 3.1, 5.8 and 7.9 specify 24 PVZ with 18 Mesh nodes, 60 SKU, eight categories and a 2000-order comparison set.
verified_findings.evidence: The reviewed StateManager initializes the preserved DEMO maps. Existing regression tests require only three cities and at least 14 nodes, and the source UI uses four original products. No 2000-order paired comparison was inspected.
verified_findings.impact: Do not claim acceptance at the full TZ dataset scale without extending it and measuring the resulting workload.

verified_findings.requirement: TZ section 7.6 requires one versioned tariff source including all rates and limits.
verified_findings.evidence: CostEngine uses DEFAULT_TARIFFS but seller storage increments remain literal 140/180/300 kopecks; planning regional profiles are also embedded literals. No tariffs.yaml implementation was found in the reviewed scope.
verified_findings.impact: Changing a model rate cannot consistently update every screen and operation from one configuration source.

verified_findings.requirement: User part 11.1 requires presentation claims and financial calculations to agree without forcing erroneous values.
verified_findings.evidence: Presentation slide 3 labels sorting saving as 3 rubles. TZ section 4.2 and corrected report use sorting 14 versus 10 rubles, a 4-ruble difference. The exact control saving is 7.04, whereas the presentation uses the rounded 7-ruble scale scenario.
verified_findings.impact: Preserve the approved original, document the sorting discrepancy, and label rounded scale arithmetic separately from exact per-order arithmetic.

verified_findings.origin: Offline claims exceed implemented synchronization scope
verified_findings.requirement: Presentation slide 5 claims offline work with subsequent synchronization and redundant communication channels.
verified_findings.evidence: The workspace settings accurately disclose local browser state and lack of real server synchronization. LocalStorage persistence is not multi-node conflict resolution or redundant channels.
verified_findings.impact: Map this presentation claim to a roadmap item, not a completed function.

verified_findings.origin: Physical scanning claim is not implemented
verified_findings.requirement: Presentation slide 5 claims mandatory scanning at each handoff and material responsibility.
verified_findings.evidence: Current order transitions are buttons without scan-token validation or a hardware scanner integration. A virtual handoff journal is implemented, but that does not establish physical scanning.
verified_findings.impact: Identify this as simulated handoff confirmation or add explicit barcode validation and responsibility events.

required_fixes: First resolve SA-01 by making batch identity globally unique or node-scoped and reject ambiguous imported batch identifiers; prove reservation/issue cannot touch another node.
Resolve SA-02 by recording aging bucket transitions in the same event journal and add reconcile assertions immediately after large virtual-time steps.
Add explicit MCS availability policy producing only viable C1/C2 candidates, with a regression test for state.mcsStatus=error.
Implement a mandatory expired-stock withdrawal task with real transit and hub receipt, or mark the unsupported presentation claim as planned until implemented.
Implement operational timing bonuses/penalties and hourly load counters before claiming full partner economics.
Support atomic FIFO allocation across multiple lots or explicitly reject that unsupported input with an honest limitation.
Connect ordinary buyer orders to shared trip batches and departure windows; retain nonzero marginal cost for existing transport.
Validate inspected-return disposition against demand and capacity, post actual return route costs once, and expose the resulting seller economics.
Use the specified MAD dispersion or document a mathematically justified alternative; centralize remaining literal model rates.
Complete a slide-by-slide PRESENTATION-MATRIX with implemented, simulated and planned status; include source slide 3 sorting discrepancy and offline/scanning gaps.
limitations: This is a read-only audit of a moving working tree based on branch feature/codex-v8 after commit e56e0d8. The root agent is editing concurrently; recheck each finding before final publication.

The supplied text files were read in several tool chunks; some long command outputs were truncated. Specific quoted sections and reproduced defects are verified, but full-document exhaustiveness is not claimed by this child audit.
This child inspected extracted presentation text only; visual rendering and all five slides were handled by the parent agent.
No browser or performance pass is inferred from the source inspection. No external human specialists were involved.
The original organizer description permits a local prototype for the first-year nomination; absence of SQL, Docker or a complex API is not itself a critical failure.
